lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A multi-row grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters is positioned across the mid-lateral flank, extending horizontally from the posterior gill region toward the caudal section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal ridges to form a rectangular grid, where circular high-luminance blobs serve as nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical transition from high-luminance edges to lower-luminance shadow regions directly below.

other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than the primary clusters on the lateral flank.
